name: HandleEditCommand
meaning: Queues Control down, a letter's down and up, and Control up for an Edit menu command

name: InstallMenus
meaning: Sets up the menu bar and registers the handlers of its commands, the Edit commands among them

name: SetTextInputActive
meaning: Stores whether text input is active and activates or deactivates the text-services document

name: InitTextServices
meaning: Creates and activates the text-services document, deactivates it and clears the text-input flag if set, adds a timer

name: HandleTextInputEvent
meaning: Queues a key's UTF-16 text, units from 0x20 as kind-1 records and U+0008 as a BACKSPACE press, unless Command is held

name: EnqueueInputRecord
signature: void __cdecl (uint32_t kind, uint32_t a, uint32_t b, uint32_t c, uint32_t d)
meaning: Queues a five-dword record in the input ring, dropping the oldest when it is full

name: HandleCarbonEvent
meaning: Turns Carbon keyboard and command events into input records, and hands text-input events to mac:033a7c

name: OsInputGetEvent
meaning: Yields the oldest input record, pumping Carbon events first when the ring is empty

name: RegisterCommandHandler
meaning: Stores a command ID and its handler in a node of the command table

name: DispatchEvent
meaning: Calls a category's handlers until one returns 0, after updating the held keys on 8 and 9; a held key's 8 goes as 0xa

name: ProcessInputRecords
meaning: Turns each pending input record into its event category and payload and dispatches it

name: BuildKeyChord
meaning: Builds the chord string of a key event, or fails for a count above 1 or a name that does not fit

name: EncodeUtf8
meaning: Writes a code point in UTF-8 and a NUL, and returns the end
